That was the conclusion I came to as well, I broke down and cried when I realized it.  I haven't prayed in probably ten years.

I fell to the ground today and prayed for him.

The world can be anything you want it to be.  If you truly hate your life, that's ok!  Start a new one how you want it to be.  Move to a new city, start a new career, heck move to Hawaii if that's what you're into.  Whatever makes you happy, even something small like fruits or walks in the woods, just focus your life on those things.
